title: Grain Desk Standing Rule: The Base Roll Rate and the Member's Crop Input Account
content:
The base roll rate a member is worked at on Grain Marketing Contracts follows their standing on the crop input account they hold under Crop Input Purchasing Accounts, because a member who has already committed money to the cooperative for the season is carried on better terms.

| The member's crop input account under Crop Input Purchasing Accounts | Base roll rate |
|---|---|
| Prepay booked on that account over the last twelve months reaches 25000 and the account stands active | 0.030 per bushel |
| The account stands active but prepay booked falls short of that threshold | 0.033 per bushel |
| No active crop input account stands in the member's name | the administrative charge per bushel the member's marketing programme carries |

## Reading the bands

Both conditions of the first band are read together: prepay of 25000 booked in the last twelve months, the figure itself qualifying, and an account standing active. Prepay of 24,999 on an active account falls to the second band and 0.033. An account that is not active falls out of both bands whatever prepay was booked, and the rate is then the one the member's marketing programme carries.

## Illustration on hypothetical figures

On a hypothetical 6,000 chargeable bushels, a member whose crop input account is active with 31,000 of prepay booked in the last twelve months is worked at 0.030, being 180.00 before anything else is brought to it. The same member with 12,000 of prepay booked is worked at 0.033, being 198.00.
